summary: A forged alg none token read every private note as admin, and page 1 of every list skips three items. Both were proven by running Node scripts against the real code in the sandbox, and both patches were verified: the proofs now fail and the existing tests still pass.

findings.title: Unsigned tokens accepted (alg none)
findings.claim: verify skips the signature when the header says alg none, so anyone can mint an admin token and read all private notes.
findings.output: PROOFBOX_CONFIRMED forged unsigned token read 2 private notes: alice, bob

fix.summary: Reject every alg except HS256 instead of trusting alg none.

findings.title: Pagination skips the first page
findings.claim: paginate treats a 1 based page as 0 based, so page 1 returns items 4 to 6 and items 1 to 3 are never shown.

fix.summary: Start at (page - 1) * size so page 1 returns the first items.
